method: Native continuous open rectangular rails with rounded corner normals; original flat UV deck and native action with soft procedural slat shoulders; rebuilt beveled ladder frame, warm grain, shoes and attached pegs. No raster retouch. Native object-coordinate camera radiance on rectangular rails keeps an uninterrupted rounded light shoulder at open ends. Deck mixes65% native periodic emission with35% BSDF. Supports22% common emission lift. No external raster textures; Standard view; broad85W overhead,4x30W fills and uniform.32 world. Deterministic native camera-ray toon radiance for exact RGB/alpha compositing of flat source deck: one TABULATED_SOBOL sample, scrambling_distance0, BOX1, denoisingOFF. Shaders use original UV phase, rail-local x/z, per-mesh wood coordinates and horizontally symmetric normal-Z response. BSDF transport remains for noncamera rays. Leg fasteners placed below deck to be visible.
